BiblicalUsage: Shuchah was an Israelite of Judah's line, the brother of Chelub, who fathered Mehir, the father of Eshton. His name appears once, in the families of Judah, and nothing more is told about him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a single verse can hold a whole life. Shuchah fathered Mehir, and Mehir fathered Eshton, and I hold that God counts the links in the chain even when we only see one.
